title: PATHE: A Privacy-Preserving Database Pattern Search Platform with Homomorphic Encryption
problem: Database pattern search requires sensitive data handling, raising privacy concerns in centralized query systems.
motivation: Homomorphic encryption enables privacy-preserving database operations without exposing query data to the database server.
method: Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) combined with Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC) for encrypted search. CXL-based hardware accelerator for FHE/HDC co-processing. Demonstrated on protein spectra database queries.
key_novelty: First FHE+HDC co-design accelerator for privacy-preserving database pattern search.
contributions: FHE+HDC combined approach for encrypted search
limitations: Scalability to very large databases not addressed; communication overhead of encrypted queries not analyzed.
